default_quota_snapshot.scoping_note: Search requests, including pagination, debit the separate search call bucket; video/channel lookups use the shared other-method bucket. Values are defaults, not a credential's observed allocations.

collection_protocol.action: Specify intended estimand, topics, geography, language, content formats, fixed time windows and explicit target units before searching
Read the actual project quota page and calendar reset time before any authorized API use; record effective configuration
Request a limited number of search.list result pages per predeclared stratum. Track each actual nextPageToken, request timestamp and returned count
Deduplicate video/channel identifiers within and across topic strata, counting overlap explicitly
Use videos.list and channels.list for authorized public metadata of already discovered IDs, with separate quota accounting
Apply blinded or reproducible inclusion/exclusion judgments and uncertainty coding without profiling viewers
Publish aggregate counts of observed items, sampling coverage, missingness, source snapshots and limitations; not inferred unique people

sampling_limitations: Search ranking, region, language, date, privacy settings and index coverage create nonprobability discovery samples.
Each request may return fewer than requested maximum; pagination requires actual nextPageToken.
Search.pageInfo.totalResults is approximate, capped at one million, and not a list of members, channels, videos or viewers.
Channels can post in multiple topics; duplicated IDs must be counted once within an estimand but their multiple labels retained.
Archived/deleted/unavailable/private videos are unobserved; lack of search appearance is not proof of absence.
Public video first-frame view counts after August 24, 2026 differ from prior counting definitions.
No individual sensitive demographics are inferred from channel names, photos, descriptions or topic memberships.
A quota budget is a technical upper bound, not a representative sample or actual achieved coverage.
Actual API requests, credentials, rights, billing and public sharing require separate explicit authorization and applicable terms.
